item.title: The 2025 Miami Art Week Vernissage at Avant Gallery
item.description: Miami, FL – December 4, 2025 – The 2025 Miami Art Week Vernissage was hosted at Avant Gallery Miami Beach, located within the iconic 1111 Lincoln Road parking garage designed by Herzog & de Meuron. item.title: Silencio with Benji B at The Miami Beach EDITION
item.description: Miami, FL – December 8, 2025 – The Miami Beach EDITION hosted a three-night pop-up with Silencio Club during Miami Art Week! Guests were enchanted by pulsing beats under the lights at Basement Club beginning Tuesday, December 2nd with Yves Tumor, Wednesday, December 3rd with Benji B, and Friday, December 5th with The Dare. item.title: WRE News: Miami Ranks Third Amongst America’s Most Fun Cities for 2025
item.description: Miami, FL - December 9, 2025 - Miami proves once again that fun isn’t just a vibe here—it’s a full-blown lifestyle: Ranked the third-most fun city in America in a study by WalletHub, Miami stands out for its unmatched mix of sun-soaked recreation, cultural energy, and nonstop activity. item.title: WRE News: Art Basel Miami Beach Sparks Renewed Confidence With Large Crowds and Strong Sales
item.description: Miami, FL - December 12, 2025 - A surging wave of confidence swept through Art Basel Miami Beach as collectors returned in force and million-dollar sales fueled the fair’s strongest showing in years. Art Basel Miami Beach drew more than 80,000 attendees this year, marking a clear resurgence in the global art market after several sluggish seasons.
